events.title: Fukuoka Tower
events.description: Seaside observation tower in Momochi with 360° views over Hakata Bay—city icon since 1989.

events.title: Ōhori Park & Maizuru Ruins
events.description: Central lake park next to Fukuoka Castle’s remains—popular jogging loop, gardens and boat pond.

events.title: Kushida Shrine (Hakata Gion Yamakasa)
events.description: Historic shrine at the heart of the explosive July Yamakasa festival and towering decorative floats.
